Name: Lad's Fishing Trawler Resprites
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
I really like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15941][b]Fishing Trawler - New Horizons[/b][/url], because it adds an interesting and unique side attraction for the player. I had a lot of fun with it by myself and especially with my bro when it becomes pretty much full on chaos!

However, I did notice that the sprites of that mod don't really fit in with the rest of Stardew Valley, especially Murphy's trawler [i](see comparison images)[/i].

What started with a sudden burst of motivation and a bunch of personal resprites, has now become a fully functional and [b]configurable content pack[/b] for all to download, thanks to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url][/b]'s help [i](Seriously, without him it wouldn't have been possible to apply the new sprites via a content pack)[/i]!



[size=5][center][b]Requirements
[/b]
[size=3]See the [b]"Requirements"[/b] section at the top of this description.[/size][/center][/size]


[size=5][center][b]Details
[/b][/center][/size]There isn't much to tell, only [u]what[/u] can be toggled via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url]:
[list]
[*]Murphy's Trawler
[*]Murphy's portraits
[*]Murphy's overworld sprites [i](Both where he sits on the dock and in his trawler's cabin)[/i]
[*]Bailing Bucket
[*]Trident
[/list]

[center][size=5][b]Translations

[/b][/size][/center]If someone wishes to create translations for other languages, [b]feel free to message me![/b]
[u]See here for details on how to create translation for your language:[/u] [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations[/url]﻿

You can open up the German translation in the [b]"i18n"[/b] of this mod's files as a reference point.

[b][u][size=4]Available translations:
[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]German[/b] - translated by Molenfeuer[/size]
[/list]


[center][size=5][b]Special thanks go to...

[/b][/size][/center][b][color=#00ffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd:[/url][/color][/b] The author of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15941]Fishing Trawler - New Horizons[/url]﻿, who also helped me with making sure that the resprites are properly applied!
[color=#00ffff][b]Molenfeuer:[/b][/color] For the German translation!
[color=#00ffff][b]MrEtihw23:[/b][/color] For the simple Chinese translation!
[color=#00ffff][b]Caranud:[/b][/color] For the French translation!




[center]And that would be all! Thank you for at least considering to download/endorse this mod.

[b]Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like!
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#00ffff] ﻿- Tea-Loving Lad[/color][/b][/center]

Downloads.Description:
Updated the Format to the newest version of Content Patcher and included a French translation.

Also fixed the version in the manifest json file, for real this time. Hopefully.

Manifest.Name: Fishing Trawler Resprites (New Horizons)
Manifest.Description: A collection of personal resprites of PaecefulEnd's mod, including new sprites for the fishing trawler, Murphy and some of the mod's other assets.
Manifest.Author: Tea-Loving Lad
